FlightsAirportCode.description: An airport's three-letter code as people say it (MCI).

FlightsCarrierRecord.description: One airline's record at the airport, against the others in the same blocks.
FlightsCarrierRecord.title: FlightsCarrierRecord

FlightsKind.description: A kind of weather in an airport's own record.
FlightsKind.title: FlightsKind

FlightsRecordLine.description: A record in one kind of weather.

bad.description: Of those, blocks with 10% or more of departures cancelled.

bad_days.description: Of those, days with a bad block of this weather.

better.description: Days the test counts on which it cancelled clearly fewer than its peers that day.

blocks.description: Time blocks of this weather counted in the record: an airport's with 3+ departures, a carrier's with 2+ of its own.

days.description: Days with a block of this weather and a peer in it the same day.

others.description: Its peers' share in the same weather on the same days, each day's weighted by its own departures that day.

share.description: Its departures cancelled in those blocks.

worse.description: Days the test counts (one cancel or more expected at the peers' share that day) on which it cancelled clearly more than its peers.
